# Canon Masterclass

> > Professional cinema training platform specializing in Canon Cinema EOS cameras, DaVinci Resolve post-production, and cinematography techniques taught by Rubidium Wu.

Canon Masterclass offers comprehensive video courses covering Canon cinema cameras (C80, C70, R5C), lighting, color grading, and filmmaking business strategies. The platform features project-based learning, equipment guides, and industry-standard workflows for aspiring and professional cinematographers.

## Key Topics

- Canon Cinema EOS cameras
- Canon C80 & C70 training
- Canon R5C workflows
- DaVinci Resolve color grading
- CLog2 & CLog3 profiles
- Cinematic lighting techniques
- Cinema camera rigging
- Post-production workflows
- Filmmaking equipment
- Low budget filmmaking
- Client acquisition for filmmakers
- Roger Deakins cinematography
- Conrad Hall techniques
- Aputure lighting systems
- Social media for filmmakers

## Training Programs & Bundles

- [Canon Masterclass Unlimited](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/program/canon-masterclass-unlimited): Annual subscription for unlimited access to all Canon Masterclass courses

- [Canon C70 + DaVinci Resolve Training Bundle](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/program/c70-grading): Canon C70 & DaVinci Resolve bundle with 55% savings on training

## Canon Cinema Camera Courses

- [Canon C80 Masterclass](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/c80): Complete training guide for Canon C80 RF-mount cinema camera
- [Cinema Camera Build](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/cinemacamerabuild): Cinema camera rigging tutorial for feature film & TV production
- [Canon Look Up Tables (LUTS)](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/luts): Canon LUTs course for color correction & grading workflow

## Cinematography & Lighting

- [Cinematic Lighting](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/lighting): Lighting fundamentals course covering techniques & tools for cinematography
- [Project Blueprint: Sub Zero Sci-Fi](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/sub-zero-sci-fi): Frozen lake filming case study for challenging location shooting
- [Project Blueprint: Low Budget Horror](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/horror): Low budget horror filmmaking course inspired by Coppola, Jackson & Raimi

## Business & Marketing for Filmmakers

- [Finding Clients](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/finding-clients): Client acquisition & business development course for filmmakers
- [Social Media for Filmmakers](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/course/social-media-for-filmmakers): Social media strategy for filmmakers: client acquisition & brand building

## Filmmaking Insights & Techniques

- [How to Use Long Lenses to Tell The Story](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/blog/long-lens-cinematography): Long lens cinematography techniques for compression & character isolation
- [Why David Fincher does 100 takes for a single Shot](https://www.canonmasterclass.com/blog/fincher-100-takes): Exploring Fincher & Kubrick's multiple takes approach to filmmaking
